area.note: Nominatim (amenity=college, Dahlonega): relation/8338296 'University of North Georgia - Dahlonega Campus', 110 S Chestatee St. All nine halls (North Georgia Suites, The Commons Buildings 1 and 2, Lewis Hall, Lewis Annex, Donovan, Gaillard, Patriot, Liberty, Owen) are named OSM buildings inside it.

areaNote: UNG has several campuses (Gainesville and others), but Residence Life says "Residency is only offered at the Dahlonega Campus" (ung.edu/residence-life), so this map is the Dahlonega campus and no hall is excluded.
noCodes: UNG publishes no building-code list: its Dahlonega building directory (ung.edu/web-communications/short-links/maps.php) and the hall and cadet pages name buildings only (Library Technology Center, Health & Natural Sciences, Nix Center), and class rooms are scheduled in the login-only Banner system (checked 2026-11-26).

housing.title: UNG Residence Life: Residence Halls (Dahlonega Campus), and Corps of Cadets: Cadet Residence Halls
housing.note: The Residence Life table lists each non-cadet hall's class (Freshmen, Upperclassmen or both). All cadets, every year, live in the Military Village (Gaillard, Liberty and Patriot halls), which are cadets only.
